# Encrypted DNS DoH DoT system settings changes in macOS 26-27 — facts

> Source-anchored units about Encrypted DNS DoH DoT system settings changes in macOS 26-27: 8 across 6 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-02 · 8 units · 6 sources · rights: quote -->

## How it works

- [statement] When mDNSResponder gets DoH/DoT designated-resolver info for the current network, it upgrades automatically and the traffic bypasses an active NEDNSProxyProvider; the proxy never sees those queries. Fleet cites Apple feedback FB11963304 as confirming this is intended. DoH on port 443 is indistinguishable from normal HTTPS, so a monitor may report zero DNS activity. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-15) — https://fleetdm.com/guides/monitor-dns-traffic-on-macos · keywords: Encrypted DNS DoH DoT system settings changes in macOS 26-27 · also: https://github.com/tailscale/tailscale/issues/20890

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Since iOS 16 / macOS Ventura, devices automatically upgrade to encrypted DNS via Discovery of Designated Resolvers (DDR): on joining a network the device issues an SVCB query for _dns.resolver.arpa and, if answered, uses TLS or HTTPS. DDR applies to one network at a time and does not work if the resolver has a private IP address. (high confidence) — https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2022/10079/ · keywords: Encrypted DNS DoH DoT system settings changes in macOS 26-27 · also: https://fleetdm.com/guides/monitor-dns-traffic-on-macos
- [statement] System-wide encrypted DNS can be configured manually with NEDNSSettingsManager in an app or a DNSSettings profile payload; individual apps can opt in with PrivacyContext on NWParameters. Client certificate auth via identityReference on NEDNSSettings is supported since iOS 16 / macOS Ventura. (high confidence) — https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2022/10079/ · keywords: Encrypted DNS DoH DoT system settings changes in macOS 26-27 · also: https://support.apple.com/guide/deployment/dns-settings-declarative-configuration-dep7e19a4b12/web
- [statement] macOS 27 adds a DNS settings declarative (DDM) configuration for DoH (RFC 8484 URI template) or DoT (hostname), with optional supplemental match domains, failover to system DNS, client certificates and on-demand rules. It does not require supervision but requires MDM with Device Enrollment or Automated Device Enrollment (not User Enrollment). (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-02) — https://support.apple.com/guide/deployment/dns-settings-declarative-configuration-dep7e19a4b12/web · keywords: Encrypted DNS DoH DoT system settings changes in macOS 26-27 · also: https://www.jamf.com/blog/wwdc26-key-takeaways-for-apple-admins/
- [statement] At WWDC26 Apple moved network configurations, including DNS Proxy and DNS Settings, to declarative device management for OS 27, with public release expected fall 2026. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-06-11) — https://www.jamf.com/blog/wwdc26-key-takeaways-for-apple-admins/ · keywords: Encrypted DNS DoH DoT system settings changes in macOS 26-27 · also: https://support.apple.com/guide/deployment/dns-settings-declarative-configuration-dep7e19a4b12/web
- [statement] On macOS 26.6.1, a network advertising DoT/DoH via DHCP DNR/DDR (RFC 9463/9462) made mDNSResponder send all queries, including local and split-DNS names, to the network's DoH resolver, overriding Tailscale DNS; scutil --dns still showed the configured servers, so 'dig works, apps don't'. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-15) — https://github.com/tailscale/tailscale/issues/20890 · keywords: Encrypted DNS DoH DoT system settings changes in macOS 26-27
- [statement] After macOS 26.1 (reports from 2025-11-09), installing encrypted-DNS .mobileconfig files fails with 'The "VPN Service" payload could not be installed. The VPN service could not be created.' even though the profile has only a DNS Settings payload. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2025-11-10) — https://github.com/mullvad/encrypted-dns-profiles/issues/18 · keywords: Encrypted DNS DoH DoT system settings changes in macOS 26-27 · also: https://discuss.privacyguides.net/t/psa-macos-26-1-broke-setting-encrypted-dns-servers-via-mobileconfig/32712
- [statement] Mitigations for DNS visibility under encrypted DNS include using resolvers without DoH/DoT, answering _dns.resolver.arpa with NXDOMAIN, forcing a corporate encrypted resolver, firewalling known DoH IPs, SNI inspection, or a TLS-intercepting proxy; all are enterprise-side measures unavailable to a sandboxed App Store app. (low confidence) — https://fleetdm.com/guides/monitor-dns-traffic-on-macos · keywords: Encrypted DNS DoH DoT system settings changes in macOS 26-27
